title: The Dust Draw
subtitle: loot with an empty band, and all_table
description: The same table, rolled two ways. `tenet:loot` includes the empty band: `toll` carries `emptyWeight: 4`, so a throw can come up with nothing at all — the one table mode where 'no prize' is a possible answer.
`tenet:all_table` is the other extreme: no dice, every entry granted, weight-zero entries and all. Between them the two rewards show the mode field deciding what a table means.
